name: Lemma Ten
source:
A celebration of the Lemma Soft Forum's 10th Anniversary! Have fun with these small visual novels and the historical reminiscing.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209200232/http://renai.us/game/lemma-ten.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
